scope: Substantive V9-V15 workstreams integrated into one supported successor; version numbers are not substituted for acquisition or analysis.

population.returns_status: Retained provisional source snapshots, not certified final returns.

acquisition.first_evidence_definition: A previously unknown field now has a qualified new V9 observation. Retained control requalification, supplementary citations and unqualified reports are separate.
acquisition.population_limitation: Acquisition and explicit dispositions do not establish universal or representative coverage.

full_suite_run.failure: The package byte-reuse test still expected current release metadata to say characteristics-v8.
full_suite_run.disposition: Updated only the expected current release version; reran that exact test successfully.

regression_repairs: Historical-observation validation excludes new V9 additions while independently preserving all frozen claim hashes.
V9-only escaped fenced-code rendering prevents command overflow at 320 pixels without changing frozen report renderers.
Root member, study, participation and publication manifests are refreshed together after normalized evidence changes.
The complete V9 archive includes the protected V8 transport receipt; every protected member is verified by hash.
Current package metadata and stable-byte tests consistently expect characteristics-v9.

offline_replay.snapshot_note: Final documentation/status corrections, the corrected release-pointer test and this receipt are covered by the subsequent receipt-inclusive replay.
offline_replay.release_protocol: Rebuild packages with this receipt, repeat extracted network-denied replay, publish immutable assets at the verified scientific commit, and verify actual release downloads. Record final transport hashes and replay in a separate excluded receipt to avoid circular archive hashes.

historical_latino_indicator.population: Independently linked historical source-classified officeholders; author-coded Latino 0/1 is not universal current ethnic self-identification.

religion_full_population_prediction.failure_reason: Holding Iowa out removes support for the opponent-incumbency design row; no silent extrapolation, row deletion or arbitrary coefficient is introduced.

interpretation.incumbency: The supported block jointly tests Democratic and Republican incumbency, not the Democratic-incumbent coefficient alone.
interpretation.donor_ideology: Selective historical donor-linked population, not a universal moderation claim.

specific_remaining_prerequisites: Explicit dated age or birth evidence; retrieval dates cannot date undated ages.
Named explicit public identity and religious descriptions or permitted source-defined classifications, with conflicts and timing preserved.
Completed credentials and dated career histories compatible with the fixed analytical definitions.
Comparable scoped prior-office and paid-government-employment negatives, not blanks, broad governmental-experience fields or advisory roles.
At least ten comparable explicit military negatives across three states, in addition to the unchanged fit gates.
A qualified native-person homepage bridge for Jen Mazzuckelli and stricter legal-name/identity support for seven California source-subject variants.
Additional compatible IA03 training support or a separately specified and validated methodological extension.
Dated pre-election service and voting records where applicable; first entrants are not assigned zero ideology.
Compatible documented donor-score coverage rather than imputation outside the selective historical population.
Restricted raw original caches are required for optional raw-source re-extraction; complete normalized research is reconstructible offline.
